commits.subject: Add `/rc` to manage remote control from the TUI (#62121)
commits.reason: Expose explicit remote-control choices through the verified local daemon. Preserve managed daemon identity through requests and responses, existing disable policy, and the requirement for a user action before enable or pairing.
evidence: Reviewed remote_control.rs local backend selection, protected daemon reconnect, settings acknowledgement, redaction and bounded RPC outcomes. Run parked-local-from-Cloud, backend switch, no managed daemon, redaction and timed-out mutation cases.
commits.revisit: Revisit activation for a native backend only after its existing remote-control disable settings and backend identity checks are exercised on the integrated code.

commits.subject: Restrict control of the Windows sandbox service (#62122)
commits.reason: Harden Windows sandbox service control before running the service lifecycle, preserving setup and query access. A policy-application failure remains visible as a startup failure.
evidence: Reviewed service_main_inner and harden_service_dacl, including explicit descriptor cleanup. Verify Windows startup, ordinary setup/query access, denied unprivileged control and administrative stop/uninstall.
